description: Exact minimum internal excess of path covers of the cube component C1 = {2,3,4,5,6,7,23,24,25,26,27} by c paths in the single-opening option model (C2 is its image under the family group). Metric 'true': EMAX = 3 MIP whose optimum equals the true cost; metric 'capped3': EMAX = 2 relaxation (e >= 3 counted as 3), used by the SAT encoding. Solver: HiGHS MIP (exact, Gavish-Graves flow). Single-opening only.
